title: Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service HJS Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Admit card for Delhi Higher Judicial Service examination stages as notified
qualification: Advocate with prescribed years of practice as per Delhi HJS rules
ageLimit: As per Delhi Higher Judicial Service Rules
applicationFee: As per Delhi High Court HJS notification
selectionProcess: Preliminary → Mains → Viva-Voce as per HJS scheme
documentsRequired: Application credentials; printed admit card; photo ID; advocate documents if required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://delhihighcourt.nic.in
2. Open Recruitment / HJS Admit Card link
3. Login with registered credentials
4. Download and print admit card
5. Appear as per exam schedule on hall ticket
shortDescription: Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service (HJS) Admit Card 2026 – download from delhihighcourt.nic.in when the official link is active.
content:
The High Court of Delhi conducts recruitment for the Higher Judicial Service (HJS). Admit cards for written / further stages are published only on the official website.

Candidates must download the hall ticket from delhihighcourt.nic.in, verify personal details, and carry a valid photo ID along with the printed admit card on the examination day.
